To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Hsp70 stimulates the repair of DNA base excision repair lesions by DNA polymerase beta.
heat shock protein 72 (Hsp72) stimulates the repair of DNA single strand breaks by the base excision repair polymerase β.
Hsp70, a member of the Hsp family, is an effective stimulator of the DNA repair enzyme DNA polymerase beta, which catalyzes repair of abasic sites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the repair of DNA damage by the base excision pathway.
the role of heat shock proteins (Hsps) in the repair of DNA damage.
the stimulation of DNA repair enzymes by heat shock proteins and the role of these enzymes in the repair of DNA lesions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Hsps stimulate DNA repair, and this stimulation may be due to a number of different mechanisms.
Hsp70, and perhaps Hsp27 and Hsp40, are involved in the BER pathway of DNA repair, and that they are involved in the incision step and the polymerase β step, and perhaps in the DNA ligase I step.
the role of HSPs in BER has been expanded to include stimulation of the DNA polymerase β step in this process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Hsp70 is involved in the repair of damaged DNA, but not by a direct interaction with the DNA.
Hsp70 is an efficient partner in the enzymic repair of DNA base lesions.
Hsp70, which is a major chaperone in cells, also plays an important role in DNA repair.
The main takeaway from our work is that

Hsp70 is not only involved in the initial recognition of the DNA damage and the incision of the damaged DNA but is also involved in the repair process by stimulating the DNA polymerase β activity and the subsequent ligation of the repaired DNA by the human DNA ligase.
Hsp70 can be considered an important component of BER, which is a multistage process that requires the participation of many enzymes.
heat shock proteins are not just chaperones, they are also involved in DNA repair.
